integrity: The universal classification is proved symbolically. The bundled finite replay is regression evidence only and is not used as an exhaustive proof of the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies exact period-\(2\) cycles containing a power of two. It does not classify all period-\(2\) cycles, longer cycles, or all parameters with nontrivial periodic orbits.
title: Powers of two in two-cycles of the shifted Euler map
